# Subtech Ajo Solution (AjoFlow)

> Digital ajo savings for Nigeria. Create target or general savings plans, automate contributions, track every cycle in a passbook, and receive payouts to a verified bank account.

Subtech Ajo Solution is the company behind AjoFlow, a web app at https://ajoflow.com. It is not a bank. Payments are processed through licensed partners such as Monicredit.

## Site

- [Home](https://ajoflow.com): Product overview, how it works, features, FAQs
- [About](https://ajoflow.com/about): Company and product background
- [Contact](https://ajoflow.com/contact): Support email and in-app help
- [Sign up](https://ajoflow.com/signup): Create an account
- [Log in](https://ajoflow.com/login): Existing members
- [Terms of Service](https://ajoflow.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://ajoflow.com/privacy)

Authenticated app areas (dashboard, savings, wallet, passbook, support tickets) are private and should not be indexed.

## Product facts

- Audience: adults 18+ in Nigeria with a valid bank account
- Plan types: target savings and general savings
- Frequencies: daily, weekly, monthly
- KYC is required before full payout access
- Platform account creation does not charge a hidden fee; payment partners may have processing windows
- Sponsor: AMK 69 Project 1
